item.text: I’m building the 8B discovery dossier around Biden’s 2022 governing program, then checking whether it turned into budgets, appointments, implementation, and measurable progress. I’ll separate direct program evidence from independent outcome checks and keep this as discovery only, with no score.

I hit a sandbox issue reading the local skill file, so I’m falling back to web research and source-level verification. Next I’m collecting primary program documents plus independent reporting that tie Biden’s 2022 statements to concrete implementation and outcomes.
